newsitem.title: HONG KONG: NatWest sets Equity Return Notes on Taiwan Index.
newsitem.headline: NatWest sets Equity Return Notes on Taiwan Index.

text.p: NatWest Financial Products plc said on Thursday it has issued 200,000 Equity Return Notes (ERNer) relating to the TSE Taiwan Weighted Price Index (TWPI) at an issue price of US$239.47 per ERNer.

Each ERNer provides investors with the price appreciation or depreciation of the U.S. dollar value of the TWPI and are redeemable in the U.S. dollar value at any time within the redemption period from October 4, 1996 to March 12, 1998 at its redemption value.

Redemption value is equal to the closing level of the TWPI on the redemption date divided by the prevailing exchange rate of the U.S. dollar and Taiwan dollar at the time at which the TSE closes for that day.
The ERNers will be listed in Luxembourg and the governing law is English.
